previous_selected10_independent_finding.title: Native cleanup exit passes an unsupported keyword to call_soon_threadsafe
previous_selected10_independent_finding.trigger: native_app_exit action or the useful-boundary cleanup invokes native_cleanup_exit.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.defect: prompt.loop.call_soon_threadsafe(..., exception=EOFError()) cannot forward keyword arguments to Application.exit. The native asyncio API accepts callback, positional args, and context only; this raises TypeError before any Handle is created.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.change: Use one fixed Source-owned callback/partial of the exact qualified Application.exit with its exception argument bound, schedule with the retained original Application context, and retain actual enqueue/dispatch/generation/closure evidence without claiming execution from enqueue.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.qualification: Trusted stdlib BaseEventLoop signature inspected as bytes/AST; no loop or callback executed.

current_selected11_author_repair.rationale: Fixed Source NativeCommand dispatch binds EOFError keyword at exact Application.exit invocation; valid call_soon_threadsafe(callback, context=retained original Application.context), exact prompt/thread/context generation, enqueue and observed dispatch/return/closure separate.
